title: Judges Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on Judges 9: Abimelech's rise and fall, with the murder of his brothers, Jotham's parable of the trees, Gaal's revolt and the millstone at Thebez.

questions.text: To whom did Abimelech go when he went to Shechem?
questions.explanation: Abimelech went to Shechem to his mother's brothers and spoke with them and with all the family of his mother's father.

answers.text: Zebul the ruler of the city

questions.text: From where did the men of Shechem take the seventy pieces of silver they gave Abimelech?
questions.explanation: They gave him seventy pieces of silver out of the house of Baal Berith, with which he hired vain and reckless fellows.

questions.text: Which son of Jerubbaal escaped when his brothers were killed on one stone?
questions.explanation: Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left, for he hid himself.

questions.text: From the top of which mountain did Jotham call out to the men of Shechem?
questions.explanation: Jotham went and stood on the top of Mount Gerizim and lifted up his voice.

questions.text: In Jotham's parable, which plant told the trees to come and take refuge in its shade?
questions.explanation: The bramble said to the trees, "If in truth you anoint me king over you, then come and take refuge in my shade."

questions.text: How long was Abimelech prince over Israel?
questions.explanation: Abimelech was prince over Israel three years.

questions.text: Who heard Gaal's words and craftily sent messengers to warn Abimelech?
questions.explanation: Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal, his anger burned, and he sent messengers to Abimelech craftily.

questions.text: After Abimelech took the city of Shechem and beat it down, what did he sow it with?
questions.explanation: He beat down the city and sowed it with salt.

questions.text: What did Abimelech and his people put at the base of the stronghold before setting it on fire?
questions.explanation: Each person cut down a bough, followed Abimelech, put them at the base of the stronghold and set it on fire.

answers.text: Bundles of straw from the threshing floor
Boughs they had cut down from the trees
Carts full of dry grain and wood

questions.text: How was Abimelech's skull broken when he came near the door of the tower to burn it?
questions.explanation: Abimelech came near the door of the tower to burn it with fire, and a certain woman cast an upper millstone on his head and broke his skull.

answers.text: An archer shot him from the roof
A woman threw an upper millstone on his head
A wall of the tower collapsed on him
His armor bearer struck him with a sword
